not_a_claim: No point-in-time trial-event panel or historical security data is fitted; no evidence of a trading edge is represented.

biological_and_market_outcomes.clinical_success: Legacy metric label for program advancement: Phase II to Phase III or Phase III to NDA/BLA; it does not mean an individual trial met its primary endpoint.
biological_and_market_outcomes.stock_reaction: Sampled separately from phase- and clinical-outcome-conditional probabilities of a positive reaction, with independent positive/negative gap sizes and market noise.
biological_and_market_outcomes.interpretation: Program advancement is not equivalent to positive stock return; positive reactions can follow suspension and negative reactions can follow advancement.
biological_and_market_outcomes.parameter_status: Phase advancement priors are anchored to published 2011-2020 all-indication transition rates; event-level outcomes are not fitted. Market-reaction probabilities, gaps, and daily price parameters remain illustrative and uncalibrated.

configuration.exploration_schedule: epsilon=max(0.04, 0.35 * (1 - episode / training_episodes)); linear decay with 0.04 floor

clinical_transition_source.citation: BIO, Informa Pharma Intelligence, and QLS Advisors, Clinical Development Success Rates and Contributing Factors 2011-2020 (2021)
clinical_transition_source.scope_note: Published aggregates from proprietary Biomedtracker and Pharmapremia program-transition data; advancement vs suspension, not per-trial endpoint success.

assumption_provenance.interpretation: Hash identifies the exact JSON config file when run through scripts/run_rl_study.py; direct API runs hash canonicalized parameter values.

evaluation_protocol.episodes: matched independent random seeds sampled from the same synthetic generator family used in training
evaluation_protocol.interpretation: Checks simulator behavior and seed variation only; it does not test historical or new-regime generalization.

metric_definitions.learning_reward: Q-learning maximizes sum(gamma**k * log(1 + net_return_k)). At gamma=1 in this finite-horizon environment, this equals log terminal wealth; gamma below one is a time-preference sensitivity and no longer equals terminal log wealth.
metric_definitions.catalyst_unconditional_expected_shortfal: Mean underlying issuer return in the worst ceil(5% of event observations); independent of policy exposure.
metric_definitions.catalyst_policy_net_expected_shortfall_9: Mean strategy net return on event sessions in its worst ceil(5%); includes zero-return cash exposure and transaction costs.
metric_definitions.annual_turnover: Sum of absolute daily exposure changes multiplied by 252 / episode length.
metric_definitions.episode_sample_size: Each evaluation seed contributes one episode per policy; catalyst-tail denominators are also reported per episode.

state_encoding.visit_counts_include: all epsilon-greedy training actions; evaluation paths are not included

paired_comparison_interpretation: Intervals resample matched synthetic evaluation episode seeds and describe uncertainty under this one fixed generator and trained policy. They are not historical-market confidence intervals, do not include policy-training uncertainty, and do not establish statistical significance or a trading edge.

evaluation_event_process_summary.interpretation: Synthetic generator diagnostics across unique matched evaluation paths; advancement and stock reaction are separate draws. Advancement priors use published aggregate transitions; these counts are not empirical event-panel estimates.
